brief:
Summary: Jimmy Kimmel interviews actor Miles Teller about hosting the MLB All-Star Game in Philadelphia, being a Philly sports fan, getting mistaken for Bruce Springsteen at a World Series game, growing up in Florida around manatees, and his new movie Paper Tiger.
People: Jimmy Kimmel; Miles Teller; John Middleton; Bruce Springsteen; James Gray
Context: Jimmy Kimmel Live talk show appearance where Miles Teller promotes his new movie Paper Tiger and discusses various personal anecdotes about sports and his upbringing.
Unclear: The exact details of how the mistake of confusing Miles Teller's dad with Bruce Springsteen happened on the Jumbotron are briefly glossed over.
